description.value: For all raw materials used (raw materials, operating materials, packaging), the transportation distance is recorded. A payload factor of 50% is used for all truck transports (suppliers, disposal transports and internal transports), which corresponds to a full delivery and empty return journey. Excluded are the manufacturing of capital equipment, construction undertakings, and infrastructure development, along with the maintenance and operation of capital equipment. Additionally, activities related to personnel, as well as energy and water consumption associated with company management and sales, are also excluded. For module A4 (Transportation from the production gate to the construction site), it is estimated that the international transport includes 19000 km by ship and 1000 km by lorry (85% payload).  For module C1 (Demolition), the process and amount of the generic dataset ‘Polyester weefsel’ (EN: polyester fabric) from chapter 22.46 Grondwapening en grondscheiding (EN: 22.46 Soil reinforcement and soil separation) of the programme DuboCalc (Database version NMD 1.10) is used. In this generic dataset, 0.0013 hrs work of the process “Hydraulic excavator (average)” per m² of geotextile are assumed for demolition, which refers to 0.0056 hrs work per kg of geotextile. For the End-of-life stage, the NMD szenario PE/PP soil reinforcement (geotextile and geogrid) is chosen. According to this scenario, 25% of the geogrid remains in the subground, while 70% is incinerated and 5% is recycled. The scenarios included are currently in use and are representative for one of the most likely scenario alternatives.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: This EPD represents an Average-EPD, applicable when the environmental impacts of the declared products differ by less than 10%. The declared products refer to E'GRID® xxxx(L), E’GRID® SXxxxx(L)T and E’GRID® RXxxxx products which are biaxial geogrids made from an extruded polypropylene sheet. This sheet is then punched and oriented in two directions so that the resulting ribs of the square or rectangular apertures have a high degree of molecular orientation that continues throughout the mass of the integral node. The manufacturing is located at BOSTD Geosynthetics Qingdao Ltd., No. 8, Ronghai 1st Road, Qingda Industrial Zone, Chengyang District, Qingdao, Shandong, China. The geogrids are made from PP granulates. In the first step granulates are melted and then extruded. After that the extruded sheet passes the punching process. Depending on the specific product the punches differ in size. The punched sheet is then stretched. The result is the specific triangular structure of each geogrid. The products are rolled and then packaged. The products are banded with PP banding tapes and packing straps.

Dieses EPD stellt ein Durchschnitts-EPD dar, das anwendbar ist, wenn sich die Umweltauswirkungen der deklarierten Produkte um weniger als 10 % unterscheiden. Die deklarierten Produkte beziehen sich auf E'GRID® xxxx(L), E’GRID® SXxxxx(L)T und E’GRID® RXxxxx, bei denen es sich um biaxiale Geogitter handelt, die aus einer extrudierten Polypropylenplatte hergestellt werden. Diese Platte wird anschließend gestanzt und in zwei Richtungen gereckt, sodass die Rippen der quadratischen oder rechteckigen Öffnungen einen hohen Grad an molekularer Orientierung aufweisen, der sich bis in die Masse der integralen Knotenpunkte fortsetzt.

Die Herstellung erfolgt bei BOSTD Geosynthetics Qingdao Ltd., No. 8, Ronghai 1st Road, Qingda Industrial Zone, Chengyang District, Qingdao, Shandong, China.

Die Geogitter werden aus PP-Granulat hergestellt. Im ersten Schritt wird das Granulat geschmolzen und anschließend extrudiert. Danach durchläuft die extrudierte Platte den Stanzprozess. Abhängig vom spezifischen Produkt unterscheiden sich die Stanzungen in der Größe. Die gestanzte Platte wird anschließend gereckt. Das Ergebnis ist die spezifische biaxiale Struktur jedes Geogitters.

Die Produkte werden aufgerollt und anschließend verpackt. Sie werden mit PP-Umreifungsbändern und Packbändern gebündelt.

technologicalApplicability.value: E'GRID® xxxx(L), E’GRID® SXxxxx(L)T and E’GRID® RXxxxx geogrids are used for the reinforcement of soils in the construction of roads, other trafficable areas, railways, earthworks, foundations, retaining structures, reservoirs, dams, canals, solid and liquid waste disposals and erosion control structures.

E'GRID® xxxx(L), E’GRID® SXxxxx(L)T und E’GRID® RXxxxx Geogitter werden zur Bewehrung von Böden beim Bau von Straßen, anderen befahrbaren Flächen, Eisenbahnen, Erdarbeiten, Fundamenten, Stützbauwerken, Reservoirs, Dämmen, Kanälen, Anlagen zur festen und flüssigen Abfallentsorgung sowie Erosionsschutzbauwerken eingesetzt.
